optimizedContext.value:
# Core Kernel

## Rules
- `createKernel(config, options?)` returns immutable plain `Kernel` object: nested `changes`, `specs`, `project`; no business logic, state, lifecycle, top-level use cases. Config writes use `createConfigWriter()`.
- Every exported `application/use-cases/` class mounts typed concrete entry in `Kernel`; `_shared` exempt. Adding/removing kernel use case follows this mapping contract.
- Shared resolver/factory composition creates/reuses one `ChangeRepository`, workspace `SpecRepository` map, `SchemaRegistry`, lazy caching `SchemaProvider`, `HookRunner`, `RunStepHooks`, `ContentHasher`, `ArtifactParserRegistry`. No constructor calls `SchemaRegistry.resolve()`; `SchemaProvider.get()` resolves plugins/extends/overrides, does not cache failure.
- Expose `changes.repo`, `changes.archiveRepo`, `specs.repos`; kernel `specs` excludes `SaveSpecMetadata`/`InvalidateSpecMetadata`/internal `PersistSpecMetadata`. `project.getConfig` is readonly snapshot incl `plugins`; declarations read there.
- Use same composition-owned merged registry helpers as `CompositionResolver`/`createKernelBuilder()`, no second registry source. `KernelOptions` supports repository overrides, `extraNodeModulesPaths`, additive storage/VCS/actor/parser/external-hook registrations; expose final merged core registry view and reject duplicate/unknown registrations. Graph-store registration stays code-graph.
- Project VCS via `CompositionResolver.getVcsAdapter()` calling `createVcsAdapter(config.projectRoot, registry.vcsProviders)` and cached promise. Actor: `createLazyVcsActorResolver(() => getVcsAdapter())`, wrap `PrivacyActorResolver` if configured. No `createKernelInternals`, `GitVcsAdapter`, or `GitActorResolver` construction.
- On `ChangeRepository.get()`, validated artifact drift triggers `change.invalidate("artifact-drift", SYSTEM_ACTOR, ...)` and persistence when beyond `designing` or active non-superseded approval. Preserve all drifted file keys. Read legacy `"artifact-change"` invalidations as artifact-drift.
- `RunStepHooks`/`GetHookInstructions` get merged schema hooks, never `config.workflow`. No-input `execute()` use cases conform without input validation.

## Constraints
- Kernel mandatory domain entrypoint; config mutation excluded.
- `Kernel` and `createKernel` public `@specd/core` exports.
- Removing kernel entry breaking change; kernel never exports `createKernelInternals`.
